working_crs.rasters_preferred: EPSG:26985 for NOAA DEM, EPSG:26918 for DC imagery services

street_source: OpenStreetMap / Geofabrik, with optional OSMnx GraphML
lidar_source: NOAA-hosted DC OCTO 2022 LiDAR and DEM products
microclimate_model: SOLWEIG/SOLWEIG-GPU inputs staged; UTCI/Tmrt rasters must be generated from the processed DEM/DSM/canopy/meteorology stack.
notes: The default run downloads one representative COPC LAZ tile, not all 335 raw tiles.
Run scripts/build_dc_data_bundle.py --download-all-laz to download the full NOAA point-cloud catalog.
DC land-cover and tree-canopy ImageServer exports are staged as center sample tiles by default.

outputs.noise: dBA or normalized edge proxy derived from DDOT AADT/BTS data
outputs.canopy: 0-1 fraction or canopy height in meters
